Omni Resonance UI glyph subset

This font asset is derived from LXGW WenKai Screen v1.522, using the GB Screen variant.
Project: https://github.com/lxgw/LxgwWenKai-Screen
Web distribution source: lxgw-wenkai-screen-web@1.522.0
Web package: https://github.com/CMBill/lxgw-wenkai-screen-web
Input chunks: lxgwwenkaigbscreen/{0,3,4,5,6,7,8,25,26,27,28,29,30,244,245}.woff2

The source glyph ranges were taken from the Simplified Chinese web-font
distribution, merged, restricted to characters used by the Omni Resonance
English and Simplified Chinese language resources plus required interface
symbols, and renamed internally to "Omni Resonance UI". The packaged file is
a glyph subset, not the original installable font.

Packaged asset:
assets/omniresonance/font/omniresonance_ui_subset.ttf
SHA-256: ee5b0a67edf11bd33ce50977793d90b8d65b8f7591041894b6b207ceef403e09

The click subtitle adds U+51FB from the same distribution's 26.woff2 chunk.
All existing glyph outlines, advances, character mappings, names and line
metrics are unchanged. Source chunk SHA-256:
cbb2ed6b99b0b9ac4050046b3347222c8b9cdd7bf92721479c4a7d1dc374c7f2

Member management adds U+5217, U+5339, U+53BB, U+6DFB, U+770B, U+7EBF,
U+7ECF and U+8868 from chunks 3, 6, 7 and 25 of the same versioned distribution.
Existing outlines, advances, mappings, internal names and line metrics remain unchanged.

Network settings adds U+4EC5, U+4F59, U+4FE1, U+50A8, U+590D, U+6062,
U+606F, U+64CD, U+7A7A, U+80FD and U+9ED8 from chunks 3, 4, 5, 6, 25
and 26 of the same versioned distribution. Existing outlines, advances,
mappings, internal names and line metrics remain unchanged. Source chunk
SHA-256 values:

Font definitions:
assets/omniresonance/font/ui.json
assets/omniresonance/font/ui_title.json
Additional raster profiles reuse the same subset file:
assets/omniresonance/font/ui_scale_{3,4,8,16}.json
assets/omniresonance/font/ui_title_scale_{3,4,8,16}.json
Logical body/title sizes stay at 10/11; profiles change only raster precision.
